label: Applying directly to a Lithuanian institution for autumn 2027

milestones.label: LSMU: application portal opens
milestones.note: LSMU advises applying as early as possible; entrance tests begin in mid-January.

milestones.label: Most other institutions: their own closing date
milestones.note: Study in Lithuania says most autumn deadlines fall in June. Kauno kolegija's EU window runs 1 December to 1 June.

milestones.label: LSMU: primary application deadline
milestones.note: The system closes at 00:00, so in practice the night before. An additional round for selected programmes opens the next day and runs to 30 July.

milestones.label: LSMU: final application deadline
milestones.note: The last LSMU deadline, and the system again closes at 00:00. LSMU says an application after the deadline could be considered only if the programme still has places.

supplementarySteps: Apply to each institution through its own portal. EU citizens can also try for a state-funded place through LAMA BPO.
Start diploma recognition early; it can take a month or more.

notes: LSMU and ISM dates are their 2026 calendars carried forward one year, marked provisional.
Not established: 2027 dates at KTU, VMU, VILNIUS TECH, MRU, Klaipėda, LCC and the arts academies.
